newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline stable as U.S. sentiment improves.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline stable as U.S. sentiment improves.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were stable to slightly up on Friday in line with crude gains and as NYMEX unleaded edged higher in ACCESS trade.
"Prices have steadied a little with the NYMEX but the cargo market over here is still fairly well supplied and there's little buying around," one trader said.

Prompt lifting Eurograde barges were offered at $191 in early business around $1 higher from Thursday but buying interest remained pegged back to around $188 fob ARA. Cargoes were steady at $196/198 cif NWE.

Bearish U.S. inventory data, particularly for gasoline, continues to haunt traders, and both NYMEX heating oil and unleaded gasoline futures fell from highs pulling the rest of the complex with them this week.
However, the hefty inventory builds were being offset by a change in sentiment and forecasts that gasoline will rally soon on seasonal driving demand.
U.S. traders said poor weather in some U.S. regions had created a slow start to spring when there is a seasonal uptick in gasoline demand leading up to the summer driving season.
On ACCESS, the overnight futures exchange, May gasoline crept up 0.45 cents a gallon overnight to 61.20 cents a gallon after bouncing off 60 cent support on Thursday.
